allowed_inputs: target reference SQL or frozen semantic target
immutable selected M4 question and verified SQL

requires: zero UNKNOWN relations on supported applicable dimensions
at least one decision-bearing MATCH relation

incompatibility_proof: any supported decision-bearing dimension with CONFLICT yields PROVEN_INCOMPATIBLE
unknown_rule: parse failure, unsupported expression, missing required evidence, ambiguity, or partial alignment yields UNKNOWN unless a material CONFLICT is already proven
entry_aggregation: evaluate each selected M4 entry independently
missing_evidence: UNKNOWN with typed reason; no optimistic fallback
alias_policy: normalize local aliases only for comparison; preserve self-join relation instances; ambiguous scopes become UNKNOWN
semantic_equivalence_claim: bounded compatibility evidence, not general SQL semantic equivalence
